_comment: Monitor-as-code definitions for Datadog. Deploy with: datadog-ci or the Datadog API (POST /api/v1/monitor), or via the Terraform datadog_monitor resource. Thresholds mirror scripts/log_analyzer.py so alert logic can be unit tested locally before being pushed to Datadog.

monitors.name: [Prod] High Error Rate - {{service.name}}
[Prod] p95 Latency Breach - {{service.name}}
monitors.message:
{{#is_alert}}p95 latency for {{service.name}} exceeded 500ms. Investigate downstream dependencies (DB, cache, third-party APIs).{{/is_alert}}
@slack-sre-oncall

monitors.name: [Prod] Host Unreachable / No Data - {{host.name}}
monitors.message:
{{#is_alert}}Host {{host.name}} is reporting no data or CPU idle time near 0%. Possible host-down or resource exhaustion.{{/is_alert}}
@pagerduty-sre

monitors.name: [Prod] Kubernetes Pod CrashLoopBackOff
monitors.message:
{{#is_alert}}One or more pods are in CrashLoopBackOff. Run `kubectl describe pod` and check the incident runbook.{{/is_alert}}
@slack-sre-oncall
